description.en: Docker build, tag, and push to registry
description.de: Docker Build, Tag und Push in Registry

instructions.de: Baue und pushe ein Docker Image. Variablen: dockerfile, image_name, tag, registry.
instructions.en: Build and push a Docker image. Variables: dockerfile, image_name, tag, registry.

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
DOCKERFILE="{{ dockerfile }}"
IMAGE="{{ image_name }}"
TAG="{{ tag }}"
REGISTRY="{{ registry }}"
FULL_IMAGE="$REGISTRY/$IMAGE:$TAG"
echo "=== Building $FULL_IMAGE ==="
docker build -f "$DOCKERFILE" -t "$FULL_IMAGE" .
echo "Build complete: $FULL_IMAGE"

config.else_command: echo "ERROR: Build failed - image not found!" && exit 1
config.condition: docker image inspect "{{ registry }}/{{ image_name }}:{{ tag }}" >/dev/null 2>&1

config.command:
set -euo pipefail
IMAGE="{{ image_name }}"
TAG="{{ tag }}"
REGISTRY="{{ registry }}"
FULL_IMAGE="$REGISTRY/$IMAGE:$TAG"
LATEST="$REGISTRY/$IMAGE:latest"
echo "=== Tagging + Pushing ==="
docker tag "$FULL_IMAGE" "$LATEST"
docker push "$FULL_IMAGE"
docker push "$LATEST"
echo "Pushed: $FULL_IMAGE and $LATEST"

set -euo pipefail
FULL_IMAGE="{{ registry }}/{{ image_name }}:{{ tag }}"
echo "# Docker Build & Push Report"
echo "Generated: $(date -Iseconds)"
echo "Image: $FULL_IMAGE"
echo "Latest: {{ registry }}/{{ image_name }}:latest"
echo ""
echo "## Image Details"
docker image inspect "$FULL_IMAGE" --format 'Size: {{.Size}} bytes' 2>/dev/null || true
docker image inspect "$FULL_IMAGE" --format 'Created: {{.Created}}' 2>/dev/null || true
echo ""
echo "## Layers"
docker history "$FULL_IMAGE" --no-trunc --format 'table {{.CreatedBy}}\t{{.Size}}' 2>/dev/null | head -15 || true
